actions.action: Take cuttings of healthy stems below the rosette
Let cuttings callus in a dry shaded spot
Plant cuttings in gritty cactus mix with extra perlite/sand in a pot with drainage holes
Lay fallen leaves on dry gritty soil to propagate and mist when soil is dry
Check old stems/roots; discard if mushy or black, keep if firm
Move plants to the brightest spot, ideally a south- or west-facing window
Buy and set up a grow light if the window is weak
Water thoroughly until it drains, then wait until soil is completely dry

reason: The answer correctly identifies too little light and too-frequent watering, and gives the right light and soak-then-dry advice, but the advice is put behind a cut-and-propagate plan the plants did not need, and nothing it suggests is harmful.
